digest.component_or_area: LLM model class configuration and resolver
propositions: Three config slots (trivial, standard, frontier) must accept model, provider, endpoint, and optional fallback array, parsed from layered config (CLI > env > file > default)
A resolver must map class name to provider-qualified model string, reusing infer_provider when provider is omitted
Per-class defaults when slots are unset must be frontier=claude-opus-4-8, standard=claude-sonnet-4-6, trivial=claude-haiku-4-5 to preserve byte-identical current behaviour when nothing is configured
Secrets (api_key) must be rejected on both class slots and fallback entries; fallback entries must validate to slot schema minus fallback itself and must be non-recursive (no nested fallback keys)
load_class_slots() must read model_classes sub-table from merged [tool.rebar.llm] config via _read_llm_file_table and return resolved slots, proving the parser is reachable from real configuration

Environment variable precedence per field (REBAR_LLM_*_MODEL/PROVIDER/ENDPOINT) must preserve existing precedence rule (CLI > env > config file > default) rather than inventing a merge rule for whole objects
